transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m… not really sure how to say it. What made me finally come in is that after I eat too much, I’ve been going upstairs and making myself sick. Then I sort of pretend I’m just tidying up or getting ready for bed.
How often have you been making yourself sick after eating?

Since last winter… most weeks, I suppose. There’s hardly been a week where it hasn’t happened at least once, after one of those eating spells. Sometimes I try to make up for it by being sick… or not eating, or walking too much.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself sick afterwards?

Yes. Not always, but… if no one’s in the kitchen, I can end up eating a lot very quickly. Leftovers from a church supper, crackers and cheese, cookies, something I baked for book club… all in one sitting. Much more than I’d ever put on a plate for a normal meal.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes… I suppose I am. Even when people say I look too thin, if my skirt feels tight or the scale is up even a pound, I feel panicky. Like I’ve suddenly let myself get huge.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without trying to make up for it or get rid of it afterwards?
Yes… sometimes. If I’m alone in the kitchen, I can go through leftovers, crackers and cheese, cookies… even something I baked for book club. It’s a lot more than I’d ever serve myself for a meal.
Is making yourself sick the main way you try to get rid of the extra calories after one of these eating spells?

Yes… I suppose it is. That’s… what finally made me say something. After I’ve eaten too much, I go upstairs and make myself throw up, then try to act like I’m just tidying the kitchen or getting ready for bed.

Yes… I suppose I do. Once I start, it’s like something switches, and I’m sort of watching myself carry on. Part of me is saying, “Linda, stop,” but I just keep reaching for more.

I… I don’t really count it by the month. It’s when I feel I’ve eaten too much, I go upstairs and make myself throw up, then I try to make it look like I’m just tidying up or getting ready for bed.
